title: J.W. BELL & Co.
text:
J.W. BELL & Co.

[N]ext comes this popular firm [that] has been doing business about [several] years. The manager, J. W. [Bell] had many friends and ac[quain]tances before he went into [busi]ness. Having been constable [many] years, his knowledge of the [peop]le in this vicinity is very ex[tensi]ve and has been a great help [in m]aking the business successful. [The] firm also affords a market for [prod]uce, which influences the good [hou]sewives to make this store a [bure]au of exchange and this adds [mate]rially to the funds in the till.
notes: Left edge of clipping cut off; words reconstructed in brackets based on context. Business profile/advertisement from early Savoy publication.
